rationale: added structural self_check (single complete 3-frame, exactly one interior 3-marker, colors limited to 0/3, 30x30 cap); accepts all 8 canonical inputs and rejects gap/second-marker/foreign-color mutations; pinned RULE_HASH = 6c9f49f37571; axis honesty: grid_h/grid_w/frame_h/frame_w now draw via GenCtx with band subranges inside declared valid ranges (was [11,20] vs valid 9..18, and frame sizes drawn by raw rng.randint ignoring overrides); removed dead axes palette_kind/palette_size/position_bias/anchor_corner/asymmetry_force (oracle hard-codes colors 0/2/3/4; position already varies via frame placement); removed degenerate textures (no_frame/no_marker/full_grid): for this task they are oracle-crashing or ambiguous inputs that a structural self_check must reject, and they returned fixed 12x12 grids ignoring dimension overrides (the KRF-0001 cross-mode bug); no texture axis is declared instead; marker placement widened from >=2-inside to the full interior including wall-adjacent cells (canonical train[2]/test[0] markers sit one cell from a frame wall); new honest bool axis marker_edge (band-weighted edge probability 0.3/0.5/0.7, override forces the mode on any band); difficulty bands now disjoint and valid: easy 11..13/medium 13..16/hard 15..18 canvas with 7..9/8..11/10..12 frames (was easy 11..12, medium 11..16, hard 15..20 with 20 outside declared valid); KRF-0001 exact-override contract: overridden dimensions returned exactly or the combination raises ValueError loudly; only non-overridden axes may grow within the declared valid range; VERSION bumped 1.2.0 -> 2.0.0 (deliberate distribution break: marker range widened, bands reshaped, axes removed); v3.0.0: canonical prior — ~30% of unoverridden draws pin 15x15 + 9x9 frame through keyed draws; self_check enforces the declared 7..12 frame envelope and one-cell outer margin (veto regression probes); marker_edge realized outcome recorded under its label (band-weighted coin); observe_overrides added (frame_h/frame_w/marker_edge); v3.1.0: replaced post-draw canvas growth with a feasible pre-draw canvas domain whenever frame_h/frame_w is overridden; keyed grid_h/grid_w now equal the returned dimensions; v3.1.0: marker_edge accepts only bool or the exact strings 'true'/'false'; invalid strings and integers now reject loudly instead of silently becoming false; added profile_signature, independent rule_mirror, and six focused regression groups for canonical parity, linked-prior stability, negative recombination, frame/canvas provenance, strict bool validation, boundaries, determinism, and return isolation
summary: The input is a black (0) grid holding one complete green (3) rectangular frame plus one extra green cell strictly inside it (the marker). Every zero cell strictly inside the frame's bounding box is painted by Chebyshev distance d from the marker: even d -> 2 (red), odd d -> 4 (yellow). Frame and marker stay 3; cells outside the frame stay 0.
